name: $OneMillion-Bench
description: $OneMillion-Bench is a benchmark of 400 expert-curated tasks across Law, Finance, Industry, Healthcare, and Natural Science, designed to evaluate language agents on complex, real-world professional scenarios requiring multi-step reasoning, tool use, and domain-specific knowledge.
reputation: A newly introduced expert-curated benchmark that is still early in community adoption, but it targets realistic professional agent use cases across several high-stakes domains.
notes: Focuses on expert-level problems with evaluation on factual accuracy, logical coherence, practical feasibility, and professional compliance.
